book.name: Akaaefeso
book.title: Lihamba lya Paulo kwa bhandu bha Kuefeso

content: Kutama muulangalo
Kya habhu, munnyighe Chapanga, mana mwenga ndo bhana bhake bhakaapalite.
Ntame kwa kulipala handa bhula Kilisto pakatupalite twenga, na kwakya twenga kakilibhuha handa nyambi ya nyanyi yinakunnogheha Chapanga.
Kiyaha mwenga ndo bhandu bha Chapanga, tela ng'obhe kukita milando yohele ya ungongola ebu ungongola ghwa kinyakali ebu lumatamata ghungunonghwa ng'obhe kukambukwa mu mwenga.
Kangi nkotoke kuyobhela malagho gha honi na gha ubhughabhugha ebu gha ubhichi, mbaha nnyobhele malagho gha kuntika Chapanga.

Mmanye pekupeku kukita yunaungongola ywohele, au yunakutenda kinyakali, au nghwimi, agho ndo tela na kutundamila ming'omong'omo, au mundu ywohele ghwa handa abho, kaayingila ng'obhe mu ghubhutwa ghwa Kilisto na Chapanga.
Mundu kakotoke kuakuluha kwa malagho ghanga mana, kiyaha Chapanga kataahyata kihyato kikulu bhala bhangannyitika.
Basi, nkotoke kulihanga na abho bhangannyitikila Chapanga.
Pamakachu mwenga mukibhegha mulubhindu, peni hinu mwenga mmegha mululangalo kwa kulilunga na Bambo Yesu. Habho ntame handa bhana bha mululangalo,
nungulongela habhu, bhandu bhaatama mu lulangalo, bhangutenda milando gha nyanyi na gha maha, na gha hoto kila linjubha.
Mwenga nkakalike kughamanya ghala ghanakunnogheha Bambo Chapanga,
kangi nkotoke kulihanga kutenda milando yanganoghwa ya mulubhindu, ngati muyibhike pekupeku.
Kiyaha, milando bhayitenda bhombe kwa lupwepo na bhandu ahakata yibhegha gha honi hata kuyikambuka.
Peni lulangalo lungubhoneha pekupeku kukita milandoahyo ndo ya tela ng'obhe,
kiyaha lulangalo lungutenda kila kilibhi kibhonekane. Ndo mana Malembo gha Chapanga ghangulongela,

content.text: na lulanalo lwa Kilisto lwabhegha kwa ghwenga.”

content: Basi, mulilolekehe maha bhula mungutama. Nkotoke kutama handa abhughabhugha, ngati nntame handa bhandu bhaabheghite na malango.
Ntumile maha manjubha ghammeghite nagho hinu, kiyaha mumanjubha agha bhandu bangutenda muno uhakata.
Kya abhu, nkotoke kubhegha abhughabhugha mu ubhumi, ngati mmanye ghala ghene Bambo kanguapala mwenga mughatende.
Nneke kulobhela ughimbi, kiyaha ghwakutenda ntende milando ya honi, ngati mmemekwe Nhuki ghwa Chapanga.
Nnyobhele kwa malagho gha sabuli, miyimbo ya kutika na tensi hya mumyoyo. Munnyimbile Bambo miyimbo ya sabuli kwa kulumba mumyoyo yenu.
Munnumbe Chapanga Tate kwakya ghoha manjubha ghoha kwa makakala gha lihina lya Bambo ghwetu Yesu Kilisto.
Angwana na ahumbu bhabhe
Kila mundu kanhokamile nnyake kiyaha mungunhokamila Kilisto.
Ahumbu, mubhahokamile angwana bhenu, handa pamunyitikila Bambo.

Kiyaha nngwana ndo kilongohi ghwa nhumbu ghwake, handa bhula Kilisto pakabhegha kilongohi ghwa ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto, handa bhula Kilisto naywo pakabhegha kilongohighwa ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto, lyene ndo mmili ghwake.
Handa bhula ngwemuko alyo palinnyitikila Kilisto, hilahila, ahumbu nabho bhangunoghwa annyitikile angwana bhabhe mumilando yoha.
Na mwenga angwana, muapale ahumbu bhenu handa bhula Kilisto pakaapala bhandu bhaanhyubhalila, kakilibhuha mwene ubhumi kwakya ngwemuko.
Ngati kwa lilagho lya Nhalo ghwake ghwa Maha kakaliyohe ngwemuko na kulighulula kwa machi,
likaho lyake, kakipala ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaanhyubhalila libheghe lya maha na nyanyi, lyanga na uhokelo ghwoheli.
Basi, angwana bhangunoghwa kuapala ahumbu bhabhe handa mibhili yabhe bhene. Ywakampala nhumbu ghwake kangulipala mwene.
Kahone mundu yohele yunakughukalaliha mmili ghwake mwene, ngati kanguulyegheha na kuubhika nyanyi, handa Kilisto pakaatendela maha bhala bhaanhyubhalila.
Mana twenga ndo handa hibhungo hya mmili ghwake Kilisto.
Matyeko gha Chapanga ghangulongela, kubhukana na nnando aghwo nngwana katanneka tate na mama ghwake na kulilunga na nhumbu ghwake, na bhombe abho abhili bhaatendekwa kubhegha mmili ghumu.
Lupwepo alu lwa hoto ndo lukulu muno, ngati nenga nungubhona lungunninga Kilisto na bhandu bhake bhaanhyubhalaila.
Peni kila nngwana yingunkwiliha kampale nhumbu ywake handa pakalipala mwene. Na nhumbu kangukwilihwa kanyitikile nngwana ghwake.
